audit.qualification: One paired sample per locked workload; diagnostic timings, not a confidence interval or parity certification. Every Emaxx result equals the actual GNU result and locked expected value; modes match. GNU identity and all measured inputs match their recorded hashes. All bodies exceed100ms. Emaxx allocation counters explicitly report unavailable; physical accounting remains incomplete. No compiler, local validation or profiling job ran concurrently. Required repeated calibrated measurement and broader correctness/architecture remain open.

scope.qualification: All16 locked workloads and32 ordinary processes completed with equal actual results and modes. One sample per editor/workload gives a3.0547 geometric mean Emaxx/GNU time ratio, range1.0942 to9.5751; these are diagnostic samples, not resolved confidence intervals. Emaxx allocation counters report unavailable, not zero. All work sizes, modes, timeout600 and tolerance1.03 are unchanged. Native preparation used identical upstream source bytes and each editor own artifact. Profiling followed timing with no concurrent local validation. Four original20-repeat profile workloads pass, but the first GNU native sample has no stacks despite sampler exit0; it is not usable profile evidence. A GNU-only80-repeat successor captures actual stacks and passes every original result/mode check. Profile durations are excluded from timing evidence. CPU samples identify VM dispatch, closure setup, function lookup/backtrace and native entry bookkeeping as candidate costs, not proof that any can be removed without semantics/ownership work. Full validation, physical counters, calibrated repeated timing, remaining architecture and adversarial review remain open.
